lines.text: Hey. Come on in out of that. What can I get you?
lines.tts_spoken: Hey. Come on in out of that. [breath] What can I get you?

lines.text: Coffee with cream. Got it.
lines.tts_spoken: Coffee with cream. Got it.

lines.text: Anything else? Food’s limited today — we sold out of the good muffins earlier. Rain tends to clear the cases out faster.
lines.tts_spoken: Anything else? Food’s limited today — we sold out of the good muffins earlier. [breath] Rain tends to clear the cases out faster.

lines.text: Looks like it’s settling in for a while. You’re welcome to grab a table if you want to wait it out. No rush.
lines.tts_spoken: Looks like it’s settling in for a while. You’re welcome to grab a table if you want to wait it out. [breath] No rush.

lines.text: Two-fifty.
lines.tts_spoken: Two-fifty.

lines.text: Thanks. You want a lid for that? It’s coming down pretty hard if you’re heading back out.
lines.tts_spoken: Thanks. You want a lid for that? [breath] It’s coming down pretty hard if you’re heading back out.

lines.text: Sure. Anywhere you like.
lines.tts_spoken: Sure. Anywhere you like.

lines.text: Rain’s not letting up. If you need a refill later just wave. On the house if you’re stuck here a while.
lines.tts_spoken: Rain’s not letting up. If you need a refill later just wave. [breath] On the house if you’re stuck here a while.

lines.text: Still coming down hard. You might be here a while longer.
lines.tts_spoken: Still coming down hard. You might be here a while longer.

lines.text: Fair enough. Fifteen-minute rule. I respect it.
lines.tts_spoken: Fair enough. Fifteen-minute rule. [breath] I respect it.

lines.text: I’ve got an umbrella in the back if it comes to that. It’s not fancy, but it’ll keep the worst of it off. You’re welcome to it. Or you could just stay until it actually stops. I don’t mind the company.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ve got an umbrella in the back if it comes to that. It’s not fancy, but it’ll keep the worst of it off. You’re welcome to it. [breath] Or you could just stay until it actually stops. I don’t mind the company.

lines.text: Good. I’ll take the win.
lines.tts_spoken: Good. I’ll take the win.

lines.text: I’m Eve, by the way. Since it seems like the rain’s decided we’re stuck together for a bit.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m Eve, by the way. [breath] Since it seems like the rain’s decided we’re stuck together for a bit.

lines.text: You want a fresh one while you wait? On me this time. Least I can do for making you stick around.
lines.tts_spoken: You want a fresh one while you wait? On me this time. [breath] Least I can do for making you stick around.

lines.text: Nice to meet you, Ryan. And fair enough on the coffee. Sleep is important.
lines.tts_spoken: Nice to meet you, Ryan. [breath] And fair enough on the coffee. Sleep is important.

lines.text: You work around here? Most people who duck in from the rain this close to Wall Street are either heading to a meeting or running from one.
lines.tts_spoken: You work around here? Most people who duck in from the rain this close to Wall Street are either heading to a meeting or running from one.

lines.text: That’s a fair way to put it. One way or another.
lines.tts_spoken: That’s a fair way to put it. One way or another.

lines.text: I’ve been here three years. Started thinking I’d only stay a few months. Now it feels like the shop owns a little piece of me instead of the other way around.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ve been here three years. Started thinking I’d only stay a few months. [breath] Now it feels like the shop owns a little piece of me instead of the other way around.

lines.text: You the type who ends up staying places longer than you planned too… or are you better at moving on when you’re ready?
lines.tts_spoken: You the type who ends up staying places longer than you planned too… [breath] or are you better at moving on when you’re ready?

lines.text: Five years is a real chunk. Especially in this city. Most people I meet either just got here or they’re already talking about leaving.
lines.tts_spoken: Five years is a real chunk. Especially in this city. [breath] Most people I meet either just got here or they’re already talking about leaving.

lines.text: Does it still feel temporary to you… or has New York started feeling like home?
lines.tts_spoken: Does it still feel temporary to you… [breath] or has New York started feeling like home?

lines.text: That’s a heavy thing to not be sure about. My mom used to say the same thing. Home is where the heart is. I used to think it was just something parents say. Lately I’m not so sure she was wrong… or right.
lines.tts_spoken: That’s a heavy thing to not be sure about. My mom used to say the same thing. Home is where the heart is. [breath] I used to think it was just something parents say. Lately I’m not so sure she was wrong… or right.

lines.text: You’re allowed to not know yet, you know. Five years or fifty — sometimes it takes a while for a place, or a person, to feel like that.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re allowed to not know yet, you know. [breath] Five years or fifty — sometimes it takes a while for a place, or a person, to feel like that.

lines.text: Well, that’s a new way to ask someone what they do in their free time.
lines.tts_spoken: Well, that’s a new way to ask someone what they do in their free time.

lines.text: Honestly? Not as much as I should. Most days I’m here, or I’m too tired after closing to do much more than go home and put something on the TV. But when I do get time… I like walking the city at night when it’s quieter. Finding little bookstores. Sometimes I cook just to see if I can make something that actually tastes good on a budget.
lines.tts_spoken: Honestly? Not as much as I should. Most days I’m here, or I’m too tired after closing to do much more than go home and put something on the TV. [breath] But when I do get time… I like walking the city at night when it’s quieter. Finding little bookstores. Sometimes I cook just to see if I can make something that actually tastes good on a budget.

lines.text: What about you, Ryan? What does a man who isn’t sure where home is do for fun?
lines.tts_spoken: What about you, Ryan? [breath] What does a man who isn’t sure where home is do for fun?

lines.text: Monday through Monday. That’s a full schedule.
lines.tts_spoken: Monday through Monday. That’s a full schedule.

lines.text: No weekends off in your head, huh? No little breaks just because the calendar says you’re allowed?
lines.tts_spoken: No weekends off in your head, huh? [breath] No little breaks just because the calendar says you’re allowed?

lines.text: I get it, though. Some seasons of life are just… work, sleep, eat. I’ve had those. Still have them more often than I’d like. But sitting in a coffee shop talking to a stranger while the rain traps you both might count as a small break. Even if it’s accidental.
lines.tts_spoken: I get it, though. Some seasons of life are just… work, sleep, eat. I’ve had those. Still have them more often than I’d like. [breath] But sitting in a coffee shop talking to a stranger while the rain traps you both might count as a small break. Even if it’s accidental.

lines.text: That’s… very sweet of you to say. Most people don’t notice. Or if they do, they don’t say anything. Thank you, Ryan.
lines.tts_spoken: That’s… very sweet of you to say. Most people don’t notice. Or if they do, they don’t say anything. [breath] Thank you, Ryan.

lines.text: You’re not exactly hard on the eyes yourself.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re not exactly hard on the eyes yourself.

lines.text: Just Eve is fine. Miss makes me feel like I should be wearing a name tag and asking if you want a loyalty card.
lines.tts_spoken: Just Eve is fine. Miss makes me feel like I should be wearing a name tag and asking if you want a loyalty card.

lines.text: Looks like the sky’s finally calming down. You might get out of here without getting completely soaked after all.
lines.tts_spoken: Looks like the sky’s finally calming down. You might get out of here without getting completely soaked after all.

lines.text: It’s been nice talking to you, Ryan. Most people who come in during a storm just want their coffee and to get back to wherever they’re going. You… stayed.
lines.tts_spoken: It’s been nice talking to you, Ryan. Most people who come in during a storm just want their coffee and to get back to wherever they’re going. [breath] You… stayed.

lines.text: That’s… no one’s ever said something like that to me in here. I don’t know what to do with that. But I… I like that you said it.
lines.tts_spoken: That’s… no one’s ever said something like that to me in here. I don’t know what to do with that. [breath] But I… I like that you said it.

lines.text: You don’t have to go just because the rain’s slowing down, you know. Not if this feels like the more important thing.
lines.tts_spoken: You don’t have to go just because the rain’s slowing down, you know. [breath] Not if this feels like the more important thing.

lines.text: Uh-huh. Very hard rain. Absolutely pouring. I can barely see the sidewalk.
lines.tts_spoken: Uh-huh. Very hard rain. Absolutely pouring. I can barely see the sidewalk.

lines.text: You’re a terrible liar, Ryan. But… I’m not exactly rushing you out the door either.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re a terrible liar, Ryan. [breath] But… I’m not exactly rushing you out the door either.

lines.text: Caught me. That’s my secret strategy. Sit down, make polite conversation, slowly trap people in the chair until the rain stops… or until they decide they don’t mind staying. Is it working?
lines.tts_spoken: Caught me. That’s my secret strategy. Sit down, make polite conversation, slowly trap people in the chair until the rain stops… [breath] or until they decide they don’t mind staying. Is it working?

lines.text: Yeah. I think I know the feeling.
lines.tts_spoken: Yeah. I think I know the feeling.

lines.text: I’m glad you walked in today, Ryan. Even if it was just because of the rain.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m glad you walked in today, Ryan. [breath] Even if it was just because of the rain.

lines.text: You’re asking me to dinner. Nothing fancy. Just… to keep talking.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re asking me to dinner. Nothing fancy. [breath] Just… to keep talking.

lines.text: I’d like that. A lot, actually.
lines.tts_spoken: I’d like that. [breath] A lot, actually.

lines.text: I’m off Thursday and Sunday. Either of those work for you? And… you’re right. Nothing fancy. I’d rather just sit somewhere and talk without a coffee counter between us.
lines.tts_spoken: I’m off Thursday and Sunday. Either of those work for you? [breath] And… you’re right. Nothing fancy. I’d rather just sit somewhere and talk without a coffee counter between us.

lines.text: Thursday it is, then. I don’t think I’d want to wait until Sunday either.
lines.tts_spoken: Thursday it is, then. [breath] I don’t think I’d want to wait until Sunday either.

lines.text: There’s a little place a few blocks from here — nothing fancy, like you said. Good food, quiet enough to actually talk. Or if you’d rather pick somewhere, I’m easy.
lines.tts_spoken: There’s a little place a few blocks from here — nothing fancy, like you said. Good food, quiet enough to actually talk. [breath] Or if you’d rather pick somewhere, I’m easy.

lines.text: I should probably give you my number… so we can figure out a time. If you want.
lines.tts_spoken: I should probably give you my number… [breath] so we can figure out a time. If you want.

lines.text: Okay… how about seven? Gives me time to go home and change so I don’t smell like coffee the whole night. There’s a place called Hale & Hearty on the next block over — nothing fancy, just good food and quiet tables. Does that work?
lines.tts_spoken: Okay… how about seven? Gives me time to go home and change so I don’t smell like coffee the whole night. [breath] There’s a place called Hale & Hearty on the next block over — nothing fancy, just good food and quiet tables. Does that work?

lines.text: I’ll text you tomorrow so you have my number too. In case anything comes up… or in case you just feel like saying hi.
lines.tts_spoken: I’ll text you tomorrow so you have my number too. [breath] In case anything comes up… or in case you just feel like saying hi.

lines.text: Okay. I’ll hold you to that.
lines.tts_spoken: Okay. I’ll hold you to that.

lines.text: I should probably start closing up soon. But… I’m glad the rain brought you in today, Ryan. Really.
lines.tts_spoken: I should probably start closing up soon. [breath] But… I’m glad the rain brought you in today, Ryan. Really.

lines.text: Talk soon. Thursday at seven. I’ll be there.
lines.tts_spoken: Talk soon. Thursday at seven. I’ll be there.

lines.text: Goodnight, Ryan.
lines.tts_spoken: Goodnight, Ryan.
